deploybot: :rocket: [staging] Deploy runway started by alex — tag `release/v2.1.0-rc5` — commit `f3a9b2c` — change window 02:15-02:45 UTC — canary=10% -> wave plan: 10/50/100
alex: kicking off wave1 (10%). watching health and traces. will call out any holds.
ben: smoke tasks queued: integ, auth, reranker smoke. logs -> `kubectl -n inference logs -f reranker-...`
jamie: wave1 smoke pass: integ auth ok, latency within baseline :white_check_mark:
jen-sre: :eyes: spotting a small 502 spike on reranker for ~90s, ~3% of requests. digging into pod logs now.
alex: pausing traffic shift at 12% until we confirm. pinning to previous stable if spike holds.
deploybot: Traffic shift paused by operator (alex). current traffic: 10%. next actions: investigate -> fix or rollback.
jen-sre: error traces look like a model hot-start timeout hitting a restart loop on node g2-12. collecting stack traces and kcprobe logs.
ops-jen: adding a temporary env override: `RERANKER_MAX_INIT=20s` to reduce hot-start time for canary nodes. pushing quick patch.
alex: applied hotfix commit `d4c7e1a` as a canary patch to affected pods, re-scaling canary subset. re-run wave1 smoke.
ben: re-running smoke suites now. reranker errors reduced, spikes gone in last 2m :thumbsup:
jamie: wave1 re-smoke green. recommending resume to wave2 (50%).
alex: resuming rollout -> wave2 50%
deploybot: [staging] Traffic shift moved to 50%. performing healthchecks and traces.
jen-sre: metrics look good, no regressions in tail latency. continuing to monitor for 10m.
deploybot: :tada: Deploy complete to staging — final status: success — tag `release/v2.1.0-rc5` (hotfix `d4c7e1a` applied) — duration 12m — final traffic 100% after wave2->full.
alex: thanks all — will run release notes draft and pin matrix for canary next week. :memo:
jamie: leaving a quick blurb for release notes: "staging deploy: v2.1.0-rc5 — reranker hot-start fix, no user-impact in canary"
ben: logs/artefacts uploaded: `s3://redwood-ci/staging-deploys/1717129000/`
jen-sre: follow-up action: investigate node hot-start variance for g2-series hardware (ticket #INF-482).
ops-jen: noted, will schedule infra validation in next maintenance window. :calendar:
